scenes.title: The Monday pileup
scenes.voiceover: Every Monday the same thing happens — six people open the same rota and start editing it.

scenes.title: One source of truth
scenes.voiceover: Halyard keeps one live rota. Everyone sees the same shift, the same minute.

scenes.title: Swaps without the group chat
scenes.voiceover: A swap is two taps — the person picking it up confirms, and the rota updates itself.

scenes.title: Costs before you commit
scenes.voiceover: Overtime shows up while you are still drafting, not three weeks later on the payroll run.

scenes.title: Close the week
scenes.voiceover: Approve the week in one pass — hours, breaks and premiums land in payroll already reconciled.
